question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘ACQUISITION’ from the given sentence.**

The head coach got surprised with the level of enthusiasm shown by the players as they all were demoralised after the first loss.
solution: The correct answer is option 4), i.e., 'Loss.' [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Let's look at the meanings of the given word and marked option: • **Acquisition**- the act of obtaining something, especially knowledge, assets, or a skill. (अर्जन, अभिग्रहण, प्रप्ति, लाभ, कमाई) • Loss- the fact or process of losing something or someone. (नुकसान, क्षति, हार जाना) • ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:​ • Enthusiasm- intense and eager enjoyment, interest, or approval. (उत्साह) • Demoralised- having lost confidence or hope; disheartened. (हतोत्साहित) • Surprised- feeling or showing mild or amazed astonishment. (आश्चर्य, ताज्जुब) • The context of the sentence is that the head coach was surprised to see the level of enthusiasm shown by the players in the game. The players were demoralized after their first loss, but they worked hard and showed great enthusiasm during the game. • Hence from the given meanings, we find that 'Acquisition' and 'Loss' are antonyms. • So, the correct answer is option 4. 3d:Tfa7c,
